coal-ink.$description: Coal Ink — Primary text, filled CTA button background, dark card surface — warmer than pure black, prevents the page from reading as cold despite high contrast

ledger-white.$description: Ledger White — Page background, card surfaces, badge fills — the dominant surface; slightly warmer than #ffffff, giving the page a matte paper quality

parchment.$description: Parchment — Hero section background wash — the warmest surface tone, used for large atmospheric areas

ash.$description: Ash — Borders, divider lines, ghost button borders

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Secondary body text, metadata labels, muted headings

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, icon strokes, nav link default state

smolder.$description: Smolder — Primary CTA buttons, announcement bar link, high-emphasis interactive triggers — warm orange against near-black creates urgency without aggression

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Data classification labels, AI confidence highlights, link color inside product demos — signals machine intelligence rather than human action

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Secondary violet accent, gradient midpoint stop, deeper classification markers

spectrum-gradient.$description: Spectrum Gradient — Hero demo background gradient — teal-to-violet-to-amber sweep used as atmospheric backdrop for the product visualization

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — AI Traffic 'High' indicator badges, positive signal states

emerald-tag.$description: Emerald Tag — Semantic success backgrounds, gradient anchor (green end of the spectrum gradient)

sky-blush.$description: Sky Blush — Hero section vertical gradient background (top stop, blue-white)

mona-sans.$description: All display and section headings. The custom GitHub-adjacent variable font at weight 700 with -0.04em tracking at large sizes compresses headlines into dense data labels — they read as precision output rather than marketing copy. Weight 500 at 24-32px handles subheadings.

inter.$description: All body copy, UI labels, badges, nav links, button text, card metadata. The wide weight range (400 body, 600 stat labels, 700 metric numerals) creates internal hierarchy within data-dense components without switching families.

sans-serif.$description: System fallback for non-critical UI chrome. Not a designed choice — browser default in edge cases.
